Grenade Ability detonations disorient enemies within 10 meters for 2.7 seconds.

Does not work with <strand Grapple /> or <yellow Young Ahamkara's Spine /> <solar Tripmine Grenades />.

source.text:
4 Piece | Augmented Explosives

On Grenade Ability Detonation: 
Disorients enemies within 10 meters for 2.7 seconds.
Does not work on Grapple. 
Does not work on Young Ahamkara Spine's Tripmines.
